title: Assign an alternate part to every component in a variant
summary: Finds or creates a project variant and adds an eVariation_Alternate component variation with an alternate library link for every placed component, keyed by unique id so re-runs update instead of duplicate; a second command reads the variations back.
phrasings: create a project variant from code
set an alternate part for components in a variant
add component variations to a variant
list the variations of a variant

commands.name: CreateVariantComponent
commands.description: Give every component an alternate part in a project variant
commands.params: Variant=<description> (default Test)|Library=<library> (default Miscellaneous Devices.IntLib)|Item=<design item id> (default Bridge2)|DryRun=true (optional)

commands.name: ListVariantAlternates
commands.description: List the component variations of a project variant
